dog.description_text:
Meet Bonbon, a 10-year-old, 15lb Shih Tzu mix who is every bit as sweet as his name! This happy-go-lucky guy is a social butterfly who wags his tail at pretty much everyone he meets. He loves people and wants to say hello to all sorts of dogs he comes across on walks.

Bonbon loves going for walks and is overall very easy on leash. At home, he is content lounging in his own space or snuggling next to his person, and he sleeps in his bed at night. He seems to be house trained so far and has been left alone without accidents. He’s eager to please, easygoing, and ready to find his forever home!

Registered adopters interested in Bonbon can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
